name: Difficulty
label: Difficulty preset
description: Difficulty preset or custom-mode marker. This is a compatibility field in the current template.

name: RandomizerType
label: Pal randomizer mode
description: Controls Pal spawn randomization: None, Region, or All.

name: RandomizerSeed
label: Randomizer seed
description: Seed used when Pal spawn randomization is enabled.

name: bIsRandomizerPalLevelRandom
label: Fully random Pal levels
description: Randomizes wild Pal levels globally instead of within each area's intended range.

name: DayTimeSpeedRate
label: Daytime speed
description: Multiplier for daytime progression speed.

name: NightTimeSpeedRate
label: Nighttime speed
description: Multiplier for nighttime progression speed.

name: SupplyDropSpan
label: Supply drop interval
description: Interval between meteorites and supply drops, in minutes.

name: EnablePredatorBossPal
label: Predator Pals
description: Enables Predator Pal boss encounters.

name: ExpRate
label: Experience rate
description: Multiplier for player experience gained.

name: PlayerDamageRateAttack
label: Player attack damage
description: Multiplier for damage dealt by players.

name: PlayerDamageRateDefense
label: Player damage received
description: Multiplier for damage received by players.

name: PlayerStomachDecreaceRate
label: Player hunger depletion
description: Multiplier for player hunger depletion.

name: PlayerStaminaDecreaceRate
label: Player stamina depletion
description: Multiplier for player stamina depletion.

name: PlayerAutoHPRegeneRate
label: Player health regeneration
description: Multiplier for natural player health regeneration.

name: PlayerAutoHpRegeneRateInSleep
label: Sleeping health regeneration
description: Multiplier for player health regeneration while sleeping.

name: WorkSpeedRate
label: Work speed
description: Multiplier for player and Pal work speed where supported.

name: ItemWeightRate
label: Item weight
description: Multiplier applied to item weight.

name: EquipmentDurabilityDamageRate
label: Durability loss
description: Multiplier for equipment durability damage.

name: PalCaptureRate
label: Capture rate
description: Multiplier for Pal capture probability.

name: PalSpawnNumRate
label: Pal spawn rate
description: Multiplier for Pal spawn density. Higher values increase server load.

name: PalDamageRateAttack
label: Pal attack damage
description: Multiplier for damage dealt by Pals.

name: PalDamageRateDefense
label: Pal damage received
description: Multiplier for damage received by Pals.

name: PalStomachDecreaceRate
label: Pal hunger depletion
description: Multiplier for Pal hunger depletion.

name: PalStaminaDecreaceRate
label: Pal stamina depletion
description: Multiplier for Pal stamina depletion.

name: PalAutoHPRegeneRate
label: Pal health regeneration
description: Multiplier for natural Pal health regeneration.

name: PalAutoHpRegeneRateInSleep
label: Palbox health regeneration
description: Multiplier for Pal health regeneration while sleeping in the Palbox.

name: PalEggDefaultHatchingTime
label: Egg hatching time
description: Hours required to hatch a Huge Egg; other egg sizes scale from this value.

name: MonsterFarmActionSpeedRate
label: Ranch production speed
description: Multiplier for item production speed from grazing Pals.

name: BuildObjectHpRate
label: Structure health
description: Multiplier for structure health.

name: BuildObjectDamageRate
label: Structure damage received
description: Multiplier for damage dealt to structures.

name: BuildObjectDeteriorationDamageRate
label: Structure decay
description: Multiplier for structure deterioration damage.

name: CollectionDropRate
label: Gathered item quantity
description: Multiplier for items obtained from gatherable resources.

name: CollectionObjectHpRate
label: Resource object health
description: Multiplier for the health of gatherable resource objects.

name: CollectionObjectRespawnSpeedRate
label: Resource respawn interval
description: Multiplier for gatherable resource respawn intervals.

name: EnemyDropItemRate
label: Enemy drop quantity
description: Multiplier for item quantities dropped by enemies.

name: DropItemMaxNum
label: Maximum world drops
description: Maximum number of dropped items retained in the world.

name: PhysicsActiveDropItemMaxNum
label: Physics-active drops
description: Maximum dropped items using active physics; -1 uses the engine behavior.

name: DropItemMaxNum_UNKO
label: Maximum UNKO drops
description: Maximum number of UNKO-category dropped items.

name: DropItemAliveMaxHours
label: Dropped item lifetime
description: Hours before dropped items are removed.

name: MaxBuildingLimitNum
label: Per-player building limit
description: Maximum structures per player; 0 means unlimited.

name: ServerReplicatePawnCullDistance
label: Pal synchronization distance
description: Distance in centimeters at which Pal actors synchronize to clients. Official range: 5000–15000.

name: ItemContainerForceMarkDirtyInterval
label: Container resync interval
description: Seconds between forced resynchronization while a container UI is open.

name: PlayerDataPalStorageUpdateCheckTickInterval
label: Pal storage check interval
description: Advanced interval controlling player Pal-storage update checks.

name: ItemCorruptionMultiplier
label: Item corruption speed
description: Multiplier for item corruption or spoilage speed.

name: BuildingNameDisplayCacheTTLSeconds
label: Building-name cache lifetime
description: Seconds that building-name display data remains cached.

name: BaseCampMaxNum
label: Total server bases
description: Maximum total number of bases across the server.

name: BaseCampMaxNumInGuild
label: Bases per guild
description: Maximum bases per guild. Official maximum: 10.

name: BaseCampWorkerMaxNum
label: Working Pals per base
description: Maximum working Pals assigned to each base. Official maximum: 50.

name: GuildPlayerMaxNum
label: Guild member limit
description: Maximum players in a guild.

name: bAutoResetGuildNoOnlinePlayers
label: Clean abandoned guilds
description: Automatically removes structures and base Pals when no guild members log in for the configured period.

name: AutoResetGuildTimeNoOnlinePlayers
label: Abandoned guild timeout
description: Offline hours before automatic guild cleanup occurs.

name: GuildRejoinCooldownMinutes
label: Guild rejoin cooldown
description: Minutes a player must wait before rejoining a guild.

name: AutoTransferMasterCheckIntervalSeconds
label: Master-transfer check interval
description: Seconds between automatic guild-master transfer checks.

name: AutoTransferMasterThresholdDays
label: Master-transfer inactivity
description: Inactive days before guild ownership may transfer automatically.

name: MaxGuildsPerFrame
label: Guilds processed per frame
description: Advanced performance limit for guild processing per server frame.

name: bInvisibleOtherGuildBaseCampAreaFX
label: Hide other guild boundaries
description: Hides other guild base-area boundary effects.

name: bBuildAreaLimit
label: Protected-area building limits
description: Prevents building near protected world structures such as fast-travel points.

name: bEnableBuildingPlayerUIdDisplay
label: Show building owner IDs
description: Displays the creating player's UID on structures.

name: DeathPenalty
label: Death penalty
description: Controls death drops: None, Item, ItemAndEquipment, or All.

name: bEnablePlayerToPlayerDamage
label: Player-to-player damage
description: Allows players to damage other players.

name: bEnableFriendlyFire
label: Friendly fire
description: Allows damage to friendly players or allies.

name: bIsPvP
label: PvP mode
description: Enables dedicated-server PvP behavior.

name: bHardcore
label: Hardcore mode
description: Enables Hardcore mode, preventing normal respawn after death.

name: bPalLost
label: Lose Pals on death
description: Permanently loses team Pals when a player dies.

name: bCharacterRecreateInHardcore
label: Hardcore character recreation
description: Allows character recreation after death in Hardcore mode.

name: bCanPickupOtherGuildDeathPenaltyDrop
label: Collect other guild death drops
description: Allows players to collect death-penalty drops belonging to other guilds.

name: bEnableDefenseOtherGuildPlayer
label: Defend against other guilds
description: Allows base defenses to target players from other guilds.

name: bActiveUNKO
label: UNKO behavior
description: Reserved or compatibility setting for UNKO behavior; change cautiously.

name: BlockRespawnTime
label: Respawn cooldown
description: Base cooldown before a player may respawn, in seconds.

name: RespawnPenaltyDurationThreshold
label: Respawn penalty threshold
description: Survival-time threshold in seconds for applying the additional respawn penalty.

name: RespawnPenaltyTimeScale
label: Respawn penalty multiplier
description: Multiplier applied to the respawn cooldown after the threshold condition.

name: bDisplayPvPItemNumOnWorldMap_BaseCamp
label: Show base PvP items
description: Shows PvP-exclusive item counts at bases on the world map.

name: bDisplayPvPItemNumOnWorldMap_Player
label: Show player PvP items
description: Shows player locations and PvP-exclusive item counts on the world map.

name: bAdditionalDropItemWhenPlayerKillingInPvPMode
label: Special PvP kill drop
description: Enables an additional item drop when a player is killed in PvP.

name: AdditionalDropItemWhenPlayerKillingInPvPMode
label: PvP kill-drop item ID
description: Item ID dropped when the special PvP kill-drop option is enabled.

name: AdditionalDropItemNumWhenPlayerKillingInPvPMode
label: PvP kill-drop quantity
description: Quantity of the configured special PvP kill-drop item.

name: bEnableInvaderEnemy
label: Enemy invasions
description: Enables enemy invaders and raids.

name: bEnableAimAssistPad
label: Controller aim assist
description: Enables aim assist for gamepad users.

name: bEnableAimAssistKeyboard
label: Keyboard aim assist
description: Enables aim assist for keyboard and mouse users.

name: bEnableNonLoginPenalty
label: Non-login penalty
description: Enables penalties related to prolonged player absence.

name: bEnableFastTravel
label: Fast travel
description: Enables fast travel.

name: bEnableFastTravelOnlyBaseCamp
label: Base-only fast travel
description: Restricts fast travel to travel between bases.

name: bIsStartLocationSelectByMap
label: Choose starting location
description: Allows players to select their starting location from the map.

name: bExistPlayerAfterLogout
label: Players remain after logout
description: Leaves logged-out players sleeping at their current world location.

name: bIsMultiplay
label: Multiplayer compatibility mode
description: Template compatibility field for multiplayer mode; dedicated servers already run multiplayer.

name: CoopPlayerMaxNum
label: Co-op player limit
description: Player limit for co-op sessions; normally not used by a dedicated server.

name: bAllowGlobalPalboxExport
label: Global Palbox export
description: Allows players to export Pals to the Global Palbox.

name: bAllowGlobalPalboxImport
label: Global Palbox import
description: Allows players to import Pals from the Global Palbox.

name: DenyTechnologyList
label: Blocked technologies
description: Raw list of technology IDs disabled on the server.

name: bAllowEnhanceStat_Health
label: Allow Health enhancement
description: Allows players to spend points enhancing Health.

name: bAllowEnhanceStat_Attack
label: Allow Attack enhancement
description: Allows players to spend points enhancing Attack.

name: bAllowEnhanceStat_Stamina
label: Allow Stamina enhancement
description: Allows players to spend points enhancing Stamina.

name: bAllowEnhanceStat_Weight
label: Allow Weight enhancement
description: Allows players to spend points enhancing carrying capacity.

name: bAllowEnhanceStat_WorkSpeed
label: Allow Work Speed enhancement
description: Allows players to spend points enhancing Work Speed.

name: ServerName
label: Server name
description: Name displayed to players in the server browser.

name: ServerDescription
label: Server description
description: Description displayed to players in the server browser.

name: ServerPlayerMaxNum
label: Player limit
description: Maximum players allowed on the dedicated server.

name: AdminPassword
label: Administrator password
description: Password used for administrative commands and REST API authentication. Current value remains masked.

name: ServerPassword
label: Connection password
description: Password players must enter to join. Current value remains masked.

name: bAllowClientMod
label: Allow client mods
description: Allows players running client-side mods to connect.

name: CrossplayPlatforms
label: Crossplay platforms
description: Raw platform tuple, such as (Steam,Xbox,PS5,Mac).

name: PublicPort
label: Advertised public port
description: Community-server advertised port. This does not change the actual listening port.

name: PublicIP
label: Advertised public IP
description: Explicit public IP used when advertising a community server.

name: Region
label: Region
description: Server browser region value.

name: bUseAuth
label: Use authentication
description: Advanced server authentication toggle.

name: BanListURL
label: Ban-list URL
description: URL used to retrieve the server ban list.

name: bShowPlayerList
label: Show player list
description: Shows the connected-player list in the ESC menu.

name: ChatPostLimitPerMinute
label: Chat messages per minute
description: Maximum chat messages each player may post per minute.

name: bIsShowJoinLeftMessage
label: Join and leave messages
description: Shows an in-game message when players join or leave.

name: bEnableVoiceChat
label: Voice chat
description: Enables in-game voice chat.

name: VoiceChatMaxVolumeDistance
label: Full-volume voice distance
description: Distance at which voice chat begins attenuating.

name: VoiceChatZeroVolumeDistance
label: Voice cutoff distance
description: Distance at which voice chat volume reaches zero.

name: AutoSaveSpan
label: Autosave interval
description: Interval between automatic world saves, in seconds.

name: bIsUseBackupSaveData
label: Automatic world backups
description: Enables Palworld's rotating save-data backups. This increases disk activity.

name: LogFormatType
label: Log format
description: Format used for PalServer logs.

name: RESTAPIEnabled
label: REST API
description: Enables the REST API required for graceful GUI control. Keep this enabled.

name: RESTAPIPort
label: REST API port
description: Local listening port for the Palworld REST API.

name: RCONEnabled
label: RCON
description: Enables the deprecated RCON interface. Pocketpair recommends the REST API instead.

name: RCONPort
label: RCON port
description: Listening port for the deprecated RCON interface.
